import numpy as np, pandas as pd, os, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
print("cwd:",os.getcwd()); print([d for d in os.listdir(".")][:20])

def parse(pid):
    rows=[]
    for line in open(f"pdb/{pid}.pdb"):
        if line.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
            if line[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
            el=(line[76:78].strip() or line[12:16].strip()[0]).upper()
            if el=="H": continue
            rows.append((line[:6].strip(),line[12:16].strip(),line[17:20].strip(),line[21],
                         int(line[22:26]),float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54]),el))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows,columns="rec name resn chain resi x y z el".split())
X=lambda d: d[["x","y","z"]].to_numpy(float)
RING=["N9","C8","N7","C5","C4","N3","C2","N1","C6"]
def kabsch(Q,P):
    cq,cp=Q.mean(0),P.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd((Q-cq).T@(P-cp))
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T)); R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T; return R,cp-R@cq

ref=parse("6NO0"); rl=ref[(ref.resn=="ADP")&(ref.chain=="A")]
Pref=np.array([X(rl[rl.name==n])[0] for n in RING])
pig=parse("2FP4"); pl=pig[(pig.resn=="GTP")&(pig.chain=="B")]; pl=pl[pl.resi==pl.resi.min()]
Q=np.array([X(pl[pl.name==n])[0] for n in RING]); R,t=kabsch(Q,Pref)
pxyz=(R@X(pig).T).T+t; pig=pig.assign(x=pxyz[:,0],y=pxyz[:,1],z=pxyz[:,2])
lx=(R@X(pl).T).T+t; pl=pl.assign(x=lx[:,0],y=lx[:,1],z=lx[:,2])

q_b=ref[(ref.chain=="A")&(ref.resi==20)].set_index("name")
q_p=pig[(pig.chain=="B")&(pig.resi==20)].set_index("name")
print("\nGln20 beta after purine-ring superposition (Blastocystis 6NO0 vs pig GTP-specific 2FP4):")
rows=[]
for at in ["N","CA","CB","CG","CD","OE1","NE2"]:
    if at in q_b.index and at in q_p.index:
        d=np.linalg.norm(X(q_b.loc[[at]])[0]-X(q_p.loc[[at]])[0]); rows.append((at,round(float(d),2)))
print(pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["atom","displacement_A"]).to_string(index=False))
# which Gln20 amide atom faces the base in each
for nm,qq,lig,edge in [("Blastocystis ADP",q_b,rl,["N6","N1"]),("pig GTP",q_p,pl,["O6","N1","N2"])]:
    for a in ["OE1","NE2"]:
        for e in edge:
            if a in qq.index and (lig.name==e).any():
                d=np.linalg.norm(X(qq.loc[[a]])[0]-X(lig[lig.name==e])[0])
                if d<4.0: print(f"  {nm}: Gln20 {a} ... base {e} = {d:.2f} A")

# ---------- figures ----------
kin=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(enzyme="wild type",nt="ATP",Km=145,Km_sd=47,kcat=0.0139,kcat_sd=0.002,eff=96),
 dict(enzyme="wild type",nt="GTP",Km=np.nan,Km_sd=np.nan,kcat=np.nan,kcat_sd=np.nan,eff=np.nan),
 dict(enzyme="ED (K46E/K114D)",nt="ATP",Km=230,Km_sd=34,kcat=0.0176,kcat_sd=0.001,eff=76),
 dict(enzyme="ED (K46E/K114D)",nt="GTP",Km=143,Km_sd=17,kcat=0.0195,kcat_sd=0.001,eff=136),
 dict(enzyme="LF (V113L/L227F)",nt="ATP",Km=265,Km_sd=50,kcat=0.0177,kcat_sd=0.002,eff=66),
 dict(enzyme="LF (V113L/L227F)",nt="GTP",Km=np.nan,Km_sd=np.nan,kcat=np.nan,kcat_sd=np.nan,eff=np.nan),
 dict(enzyme="ED+LF",nt="ATP",Km=np.nan,Km_sd=np.nan,kcat=np.nan,kcat_sd=np.nan,eff=np.nan),
 dict(enzyme="ED+LF",nt="GTP",Km=82,Km_sd=12,kcat=0.0078,kcat_sd=0.0004,eff=96)])
kin.to_csv("kinetics_PMID27478903_table1.csv",index=False)
RT=0.593
print("\nATP: ddG from Km, ED vs WT = %+.2f kcal/mol (RT ln(230/145))"%(RT*np.log(230/145)))
print("ATP: ddG from Km, LF vs WT = %+.2f kcal/mol"%(RT*np.log(265/145)))
print("predicted base-blind monopole shift at the mouth for an NTP (q=-3) = +1.17 kcal/mol (this work)")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11.5,4.4))
col={"ATP":"#2b6cb0","GTP":"#c05621"}; mk={"wild type":"o","ED (K46E/K114D)":"s","LF (V113L/L227F)":"^","ED+LF":"D"}
for r in kin.dropna().itertuples():
    ax[0].errorbar(r.Km,r.kcat,xerr=r.Km_sd,yerr=r.kcat_sd,fmt=mk[r.enzyme],color=col[r.nt],ms=10,capsize=3)
    ax[0].annotate(f"{r.enzyme}\n{r.nt}",(r.Km,r.kcat),textcoords="offset points",xytext=(8,6),fontsize=7.5)
for e in kin[kin.Km.isna()].itertuples():
    pass
ax[0].set_xlabel("K$_m$ (uM)"); ax[0].set_ylabel("k$_{cat}$ (s$^{-1}$)")
ax[0].set_title("Published kinetics on the K$_m$ / k$_{cat}$ axis\n(PMID 27478903, Table 1; blue ATP, orange GTP)",fontsize=10)
ax[0].text(0.03,0.06,"not detected: WT+GTP, LF+GTP, ED+LF+ATP\n(no K$_m$ and no k$_{cat}$ reported)",
           transform=ax[0].transAxes,fontsize=8,style="italic")
labels=["Blastocystis ATP-specific\nGln20 OE1 ... adenine N6","Blastocystis\nlinker Gly111 O ... adenine N6",
        "Blastocystis\nVal113 N ... adenine N1","pig GTP-specific\nGln20 NE2 ... guanine O6",
        "pig GTP-specific\nlinker Leu109 O ... guanine N1","pig GTP-specific\nlinker Leu109 N ... guanine O6"]
vals=[2.55,3.14,3.34,2.58,2.72,3.01]; cols=["#2b6cb0"]*3+["#c05621"]*3
ax[1].barh(range(6),vals,color=cols); ax[1].set_yticks(range(6)); ax[1].set_yticklabels(labels,fontsize=7.5)
ax[1].set_xlabel("donor-acceptor distance (A)"); ax[1].invert_yaxis(); ax[1].set_xlim(0,4)
ax[1].set_title("The same Gln20 reads both bases, with opposite\namide polarity (measured here from 6NO0 and 2FP4)",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
